items.title: Jasper Taylor Interview, 1959-06-30
items.q: I think Jeanette was going there.

ctx.x: Oh yes, I'd like for you to tell us.

Yeah, well I knew, I first met Jell-A-Roll Morton down in Memphis. And, uh, he came into Memphis as the world's greatest piano player. And I guess I was about to, one of the first to, to hear him. He had a blues, Jell-A-Roll blues. This was after Handy had published his blues. And Jell-A-Roll gave a regular concert for him and I and, uh, a couple of ladies. And that's how I first met Jell-A-Roll. And then I went out on some jobs with him, piano and drums, in Memphis. And then we came, then I came to Chicago and,…
